units.source_text: 内大臣由众公子簇拥而行，给人以威武堂皇、重实可靠的感觉。

en.t: The Inner Minister walked surrounded by his many sons, giving an impression of imposing dignity and solid reliability.
He was tall and slender, with just the right balance between fullness and leanness.

units.source_text: 由于前世积德，面貌和步态都十足具有大臣之相。

en.t: Thanks to virtues accumulated in a former life, both his features and his gait had every mark of a great minister.

units.source_text: 他身穿淡紫色裙子，上罩白面红里的衬袍，衣裾极长。

en.t: He wore a pale purple train, with a robe over it that was white outside and red-lined within, its hem trailing very long.

units.source_text: 故意装出悠闲自得的模样，令人见了觉得光艳夺目。

en.t: He deliberately assumed an air of leisurely ease, dazzling all who saw him with his brilliance and splendor.

units.source_text: 六条院太政大臣则身穿白面红里的中国绫罗常礼服，内衬当时流行的深红梅色内衣。

en.t: The Grand Minister of Rokujo, by contrast, wore a formal everyday robe of Chinese figured silk, white outside and red-lined within, with an underrobe in the deep crimson plum color then in fashion.

units.source_text: 那无拘无束的贵人模样，其美更是无可比拟。

en.t: His unrestrained noble bearing possessed a beauty that was beyond comparison.

units.source_text: 他身上仿佛发出光辉，内大臣的严装盛饰，到底比不上他。

en.t: It was as if light shone from his very body, and in the end the Inner Minister's solemn finery could not rival him.

units.source_text: 内大臣家许多公子，个个眉清目秀，聚集在父亲身边。

en.t: The many sons of the Inner Minister's household, each handsome and refined, gathered around their father.

units.source_text: 内大臣的异母弟，现今称为藤大纳言、东宫大夫的，也都相貌堂堂，此时也来问病。

en.t: The Inner Minister's half brothers, now known as the Fuji Major Counselor and the Master of the Crown Prince's Household, were also dignified in appearance and had come at this time to inquire after the illness.

units.source_text: 此外还有许多声望高贵的殿上人，并不宣召，自动前来。

en.t: In addition, many courtiers of high reputation and noble standing came of their own accord, without being summoned.

units.source_text: 又有藏人弁、五位藏人、近卫中少将、弁官等，花花绿绿的十余人，也聚集于三条邸，光景甚是热闹。

en.t: There were also more than ten brightly dressed men, including a Chamberlain Controller, fifth-rank chamberlains, Middle and Minor Captains of the Guards, and controllers, all gathered at the Sanjo mansion, making the scene extremely lively.

units.source_text: 等而下之，五位、六位的殿上人，以及寻常人员，不计其数。

en.t: Below them were countless fifth- and sixth-rank courtiers, as well as ordinary attendants and servants.

units.source_text: 太君设筵款待，酒杯频传，诸人皆醉，大家称颂太君福德无量。

en.t: The Grand Lady laid out a feast to entertain them; cups passed again and again, everyone grew drunk, and all praised her immeasurable good fortune and virtue.
